description: This file declares the interface for the video subsystem, including the CVideo class, related functions, and constants for handling video modes and surfaces in the Wesnoth game engine.

classes.name: CVideo
classes.description: Class managing video modes, surfaces, and screen updates in the game.

methods.name: CVideo
methods.description: Parameterized constructor for setting video mode.

methods.name: modePossible
methods.description: Checks if a specific video mode is possible.

methods.name: modeChanged
methods.description: Checks if the video mode has changed since last check.

methods.name: getx
methods.description: Returns the width of the current video mode.

methods.name: gety
methods.description: Returns the height of the current video mode.

methods.name: getBitsPerPixel
methods.description: Returns bits per pixel of current video mode.

methods.name: lock
methods.description: Locks the screen for direct pixel access.

methods.name: blit_surface
methods.description: Blits a surface onto the screen.

methods.name: isFullScreen
methods.description: Checks if current mode is fullscreen.

methods.name: setBpp
methods.description: Sets bits per pixel for emulation.

methods.name: faked
methods.description: Checks if fake screen mode is active.

methods.name: set_help_string
methods.description: Sets a help string for display.
